description: Story ties bind an NPC personally to THIS adventure's facts: the stake, the antagonist, the villain, a faction, the location, the destination or another cast member. 'text' is the DM-facing truth, 'speak' what the NPC says in the first person: freely when public is true, only once trusted when it is false. Each role has its own table; 'others' lists the cast roles {other} may name. Motives (why an opposing NPC acts) and stand-downs (what would make them back off or bargain) are separate tables. Original prose.

entries.text: {name} made {stake} with {pos} own hands and never told anyone whose crest is hidden in the work.
entries.speak: I made {stake} myself, years ago. There is a crest worked into it, and I have never told a soul whose.

entries.text: {name} carried {stake} once before, as a child, beside a grandparent now gone.
entries.speak: I carried {stake} once before, as a child, walking beside my grandmother. I was too small to know what it meant.

entries.text: {name} swore at a deathbed to keep {stake} from the wrong hands and fears the oath is slipping.
entries.speak: I swore to someone who was dying that I would keep {stake} safe. Tonight I am not sure I can.

entries.text: {name} spent a year's savings on {stake} and cannot afford to lose it.
entries.speak: {stake|cap} cost me a year of saving. I could not bear to see it lost.

entries.text: {name} owes {antagonist} a debt of gratitude and is ashamed to stand on the other side.
entries.speak: I owe {antagonist} more than I can say. It was long ago. Now we stand on opposite sides of this.

entries.text: {name} lost a brother on the road to {destination}, and {antagonist_the} was there.
entries.speak: I lost a brother on the road to {destination}, and {antagonist_the} was there. I do not say it lightly.

entries.text: {name} has seen {antagonist} before, in a crowd, and wishes {sub} had spoken up.
entries.speak: I have seen {antagonist} before, in a crowd. I should have spoken up then.

entries.text: {name} warned the neighbours about {antagonist_the} months ago and has been called a worrier since.
entries.speak: I told everyone about {antagonist_the} months ago. They called me a worrier. I would very much like to be wrong tonight.

entries.text: {name} has lived in sight of {location} all {pos} life and knows what it looks like when something is wrong.
entries.speak: I have lived in sight of {location} all my life. I know what it looks like when something is wrong, and tonight it does.

entries.text: {name} was dismissed from a post at {location} for something that was not {pos} doing.
entries.speak: They let me go from {location} years ago for something that was not my doing. I still walk past it every day.

entries.text: {name} keeps a key to a locked room at {location} that no one else remembers.
entries.speak: I hold the key to a room at {location} that nobody else remembers. I have never dared to open it.

entries.text: {name} wrote to someone at {destination} a season ago and has had no answer.
entries.speak: I wrote to someone at {destination} a season ago. There has been no answer. I would rather you were the answer than a letter.

entries.text: {name} once worked at {destination} and left in a temper, which {sub} regrets.
entries.speak: I worked at {destination} once. I left in a temper, and I have regretted the manner of it ever since.

entries.text: {name} and {other} were close once and have not spoken in years.
entries.speak: {other} and I were close once. We have not spoken in years, and I do not entirely know why.

entries.text: {name} was once {other}'s student and still hears {other}'s corrections.
entries.speak: {other} taught me, years ago. I still hear the corrections in my head whenever I make a mistake.

entries.text: {name} trusts {other} with a confidence told to no one else.
entries.speak: There is one person I would trust with anything, and that is {other}. I have told {other} things I have told nobody else.

entries.text: {name} pays dues to {faction} and has begun to doubt they are worth the cost.
entries.speak: I pay my dues to {faction}, like everyone. Lately I wonder what they buy.

entries.text: {name} refused {faction} a favour once and has felt watched ever since.
entries.speak: I turned down {faction} once. Since then I keep finding that someone is watching me.

entries.text: {name} once did a small favour for {villain} and has since realised what it served.
entries.speak: I did a small favour for {villain} once. I did not know what it was for. I do now.

entries.text: {name} has heard whispers of {villain} and told no one, fearing disbelief.
entries.speak: People are whispering about {villain}. I have said nothing. Who would listen to someone like me?

entries.text: {name} has waited months for {stake} and told no one how much it matters.
entries.speak: I have waited a long time for {stake}. I would be glad if you made no fuss about it.

entries.text: {name} held {stake} for a single night long ago and was sworn never to speak of it.
entries.speak: I held {stake} once, for a single night, long ago. I was told never to speak of it, and I haven't.

entries.text: {name} half-wishes {stake} would simply stay here and knows it is not {pos} place to wish.
entries.speak: Part of me wishes {stake} would simply stay here. I know that is not my place.

entries.text: {name} has turned {antagonist_the} away from the door twice this month.
entries.speak: I have turned {antagonist_the} away from my door twice this month. A third time worries me.

entries.text: {name} knew {antagonist} before the trouble and lies awake wondering what changed.
entries.speak: I knew {antagonist} before all this. I keep wondering what changed.

entries.text: {name} was frightened once by {antagonist_the} and has kept a lamp in the window since.
entries.speak: {antagonist_the|cap} frightened me badly once. I have kept a lamp in the window ever since.

entries.text: {name} has watched travellers pass through {location} for years and reads their news in the dust on their boots.
entries.speak: I have watched people pass through {location} for years. You can read their news in the dust on their boots.

entries.text: {name} left {location} for a year long ago, came back without a word of explanation and has been asked ever since.
entries.speak: I left {location} for a year once and came back without a word of explanation. People still ask, and I still do not say.

entries.text: {name} has kept {destination} open through bad winters out of stubbornness and love.
entries.speak: I have kept {destination} open through some very bad winters. Stubbornness, mostly. And love, a little.

entries.text: {name} owes {destination}'s owner more than {sub} will ever earn.
entries.speak: I owe more on {destination} than I will ever earn. I keep smiling and keep sweeping.

entries.text: {name} hid something in the rafters of {destination} and checks on it every night.
entries.speak: There is something hidden in {destination} that I check every night. It is not mine, and it is not dangerous. It is only a promise.

entries.text: {name} has known {other} since they were young and thinks of {other} as family.
entries.speak: {other} and I go back a long way. I think of {other} as family, whatever the paperwork says.

entries.text: {name} has grown wary of {other}'s habit of drawing others into trouble.
entries.speak: I am fond of {other}, but trouble follows {other} like a stray dog. I worry about it.

entries.text: {name} keeps every letter {other} ever sent, in a box under the bed.
entries.speak: I have kept every letter {other} ever sent me. They are in a box under my bed. Do not tell {other}.

entries.text: {name} passes small news to {faction} in exchange for protection and has begun to resent it.
entries.speak: I pass small news to {faction}, and they leave me be. I am beginning to resent the arrangement.

entries.text: {name} shelters travellers for {faction} and asks no questions.
entries.speak: I shelter travellers for {faction}, and I do not ask questions. It makes for restful evenings.

entries.text: {name} left {faction} on poor terms and still receives visits.
entries.speak: I left {faction} on poor terms. Every so often someone calls to remind me.

entries.text: {name} has heard the old tales of {villain} and half believes them.
entries.speak: I have heard the old tales about {villain}. I would like to say I do not believe them.

entries.text: {name} once saw {villain}'s agents at {destination} and said nothing.
entries.speak: I once saw some of {villain}'s people here at {destination}. I said nothing, then or after.

entries.text: {name} is distantly related to someone in {villain}'s household and keeps it quiet.
entries.speak: I have a cousin in {villain}'s household. I do not speak of it, and I do not write.

entries.text: {name} blames {stake} for a ruin in {pos} family and wants it gone.
entries.speak: {stake|cap}? It ruined people I love. I want it gone, and I do not much care how.

entries.text: {name} believes {stake} was promised to {obj} and that {sub} was cheated of it.
entries.speak: {stake|cap} was promised to me. I was cheated, and you are helping the cheat.

entries.text: {name} saw {stake} change hands once and has followed it since.
entries.speak: I saw {stake} pass between two pairs of hands once. I have been following it ever since.

entries.text: {name} was told {stake} would clear a debt that grows every day.
entries.speak: I was told {stake} would clear what I owe. The debt grows by the day, so forgive my hurry.

entries.text: {name} grew up in sight of {location} and resents how it turned its back.
entries.speak: I grew up near {location}. It never did a thing for me, and I am done waiting for it to start.

entries.text: {name} was run out of {location} for a wrong far smaller than the rumour.
entries.speak: They ran me out of {location} for something much smaller than they tell. One day I would like to say it plainly.

entries.text: {name} has watched {location} for a week and learned its rhythms.
entries.speak: I know the rhythms of {location}. When the lamps go up, when the watch changes. Do not take me for a stranger.

entries.text: {name} was promised a welcome at {destination} and turned away at the door.
entries.speak: I was promised a welcome at {destination}, and I was turned away at the door. I remember it well.

entries.text: {name} knows the lanes around {destination} better than any traveller.
entries.speak: I know the lanes around {destination} better than any traveller. I have had time to learn them.

entries.text: {name} blames {other} for a loss that never stopped hurting.
entries.speak: {other} knows what was done. I have had years to practise what I would say.

entries.text: {name} was friendly with {other} before trouble came between them.
entries.speak: {other} and I were friends once, before things went wrong.

entries.text: {name} was told by someone feared that {other} can end this trouble for good.
entries.speak: I was told that {other} can end this for good. I did not want to come.

entries.text: {name} would rather not harm {other} and keeps that quiet.
entries.speak: I have no wish to hurt {other}. Please do not repeat that.

entries.text: {name} takes coin from {faction} and dislikes the work.
entries.speak: I take coin from {faction}, and I do not like the work. Nobody asked what I liked.

entries.text: {name} was cast out by {faction} and wants to prove them wrong.
entries.speak: {faction|cap} cast me out. I mean to show them what they threw away.

entries.text: {name} knows {faction} well and talks about it freely.
entries.speak: Everyone knows {faction}. They look after their own, and only their own.

entries.text: {name} was hired by {villain}'s people and has never met {villain}.
entries.speak: I have never met {villain}. I take my orders from a note under a stone, and I do not ask questions.

entries.text: {name} fears {villain} far more than any hero.
entries.speak: You think I am the dangerous one? Wait until you meet {villain}.

entries.text: {name} was betrayed by {villain}'s people and wants them to pay.
entries.speak: {villain}'s people betrayed me once. I have not forgotten.

entries.text: {name} brags of knowing {villain}'s plans, though {sub} knows little.
entries.speak: I know all of {villain}'s plans. Well. Most of them. Some.

entries.text: {name} believes {stake} is the last piece of something {sub} has spent a lifetime gathering.
entries.speak: {stake|cap} is the last piece. Do you know how long I have waited for a last piece?

entries.text: {name} once held {stake} and lost it through a moment of misplaced trust.
entries.speak: I held {stake} once. I lost it through a single moment of trust. I do not trust now.

entries.text: {name} offered fair coin for {stake} three times and finds refusal baffling.
entries.speak: I offered a fair price for {stake} three times. Refusal baffles me.

entries.text: {name} holds an old claim to {location}.
entries.speak: I hold an old claim to {location}. There are papers. There are always papers.

entries.text: {name} was humiliated at {location} long ago, before everyone who mattered.
entries.speak: I was humiliated at {location} once, in front of everyone who mattered. I remember each face.

entries.text: {name} has a plan that depends on what waits at {destination}.
entries.speak: What waits at {destination} is not what you think it is. It matters a great deal to me.

entries.text: {name} remembers {other} from long ago and was kinder then.
entries.speak: I remember {other}, from long ago. I was kinder then.

entries.text: {name} has had {other} watched for months.
entries.speak: I know {other}'s habits better than {other} does. I mean no insult by it.

entries.text: {name} sent {antagonist} to do the rough work and regrets the choice of tool.
entries.speak: I sent {antagonist} for this. I may have chosen the wrong tool.

entries.text: {name} considers {faction} the only rival worth the name.
entries.speak: {faction|cap} is the only rival I take seriously. I tell them so, and they do not enjoy it.

entries.text: {name} holds a private debt note from someone high in {faction}.
entries.speak: Someone high in {faction} is in my debt. They would very much like me to forget it.

entries.text: {name} has a soft spot for {antagonist}, who reminds {obj} of who {sub} used to be.
entries.speak: {antagonist} reminds me of myself, once. I try not to dwell on it.

entries.text: {name} swore service to {villain} in a hard winter and was never released.
entries.speak: I swore service to {villain} in a hard winter. Nobody ever released me from it.

entries.text: {name} no longer believes in {villain}'s cause and cannot see how to leave.
entries.speak: I no longer believe what {villain} believes. I cannot see how to leave.

entries.text: {name} was told to bring back {stake} and nothing more.
entries.speak: I was told to bring back {stake}, nothing more. I follow orders.

entries.text: {name} has walked the roads around {location} for years on orders.
entries.speak: I have walked the roads around {location} for years. I know the faces there, and they know mine.

entries.text: {name} respects {other} and is uncomfortable about it.
entries.speak: I respect {other}, which is awkward given the circumstances.

entries.text: {name} passes word to {faction} as well and tells no one.
entries.speak: I send word to {faction} now and then. Do not repeat that.

entries.text: {name} has a sibling near {destination} who believes {name} is a clerk.
entries.speak: I have a sibling near {destination} who thinks I am a clerk. I would like to keep it that way.

entries.text: {name} competes with {antagonist} for notice and resents the competition.
entries.speak: {antagonist} and I compete for notice. It does neither of us any good.

entries.text: has gone hungry too long and is out of other options
entries.speak: I have not eaten properly in days. Tell me you would not do the same.

entries.text: faces a creditor's deadline
entries.speak: There is a debt and a deadline. I have run out of the one and nearly out of the other.

entries.text: needs coin for a sick relative's care
entries.speak: Someone I love is ill, and care costs coin. That is all this is.

entries.text: is driven by an old wrong never put right
entries.speak: An old wrong was done to me and never put right. I mean to see it put right.

entries.text: is more afraid of whoever sent them than of the party
entries.speak: You think I am the frightening one here? Wait until you meet whoever sent me.

entries.text: needs to prove they are more than a nobody
entries.speak: All my life I have been told I am nobody. Today I mean to be somebody.

entries.text: sincerely believes this is the right thing to do
entries.speak: I am not the villain in this. I am the only one here who sees clearly.

entries.text: treats it as plain work and nothing personal
entries.speak: It is work. Nothing personal. I would rather have been given something easier.

entries.text: is protecting their own people from something worse
entries.speak: Everything I do is to keep my own people safe. You would do the same.

entries.text: cannot go home until this is done
entries.speak: I want to go home. I cannot until this is finished.

entries.text: wants to be accepted by a group that keeps them at arm's length
entries.speak: I want to belong somewhere. They have told me this is the price.

entries.text: believes something was taken from them and is taking it back
entries.speak: That was taken from me. I am only taking back what is mine.

entries.text: needs to know what it is, whatever the cost
entries.speak: I need to know what it is. Don't you? Truly?

entries.text: wants to stop something from changing
entries.speak: Things were good before. I only want them back the way they were.

entries.text: needs one success to keep a position
entries.speak: I need this one win to keep my place. After this I will leave you alone.

entries.text: leads a band that went hungry through a lean winter
entries.speak: The band went hungry all winter. I will do what I must to fill their bowls.

entries.text: wants a prize to win the chief's favour
entries.speak: A great prize will make the chief notice me. I want it. I want it so much.

entries.text: has stopped hoping and wants an ending
entries.speak: I am past caring how this ends. I only want it to end.

entries.text: calls a hunger for authority a love of order
entries.speak: People need order. Someone must provide it, and it may as well be me.

entries.text: wants a place in the memory of the region
entries.speak: In a hundred years they will remember my name. That is worth more than comfort.

entries.text: backs off if offered a hot meal and a night by a fire
entries.speak: Give me a hot meal and a night out of the rain, and I might remember I am a person.

entries.text: bargains if part of the debt is covered
entries.speak: Cover some of what I owe, and I will take it from there.

entries.text: stands down when addressed with genuine respect
entries.speak: Say my name as though it matters, and not as though it were a charge.

entries.text: yields if shown that whoever sent them will not stand behind them
entries.speak: Show me that whoever sent me will not stand behind me, and I will think again.

entries.text: withdraws if promised a safe road out of the district
entries.speak: A safe road out of here, no questions asked. Promise me that and I walk.

entries.text: yields once allowed to state their grievance aloud
entries.speak: Let me say it once, aloud, to someone who will listen. That is all I ever wanted.

entries.text: backs off if someone will look after those who depend on them
entries.speak: If someone will look after the ones who depend on me, I will stand aside.

entries.text: bargains for something equally bright
entries.speak: Give me something just as shiny and we can be friends. Very good friends.

entries.text: retreats if given a dignified way out
entries.speak: Let me leave with my head up, and nobody has to be hurt.

entries.text: yields if shown their cause rests on a mistake
entries.speak: Prove me wrong and I will go quietly. I would honestly prefer it.

entries.text: parleys only for something they cannot get alone
entries.speak: Offer me something I cannot take for myself, and we can talk.

entries.text: stands down when reminded of someone they care about
entries.speak: Do not remind me who is waiting for me. Give me a moment, and I will listen.
